The '''EU LCS 2013 Summer Split''' was the second split of the inaugural [[European League of Legends Championship Series]] (EU LCS), organized by Riot Games. The regular season was held offline in Berlin, Germany, from June 15 to August 11, 2013, followed by the Playoffs at Gamescom 2013 in Cologne, Germany, from August 23 to 25, 2013. Eight teams competed in a quadruple round-robin format, with the top six advancing to the Playoffs. The top three teams qualified for the [[Worlds 2013|Season 3 World Championship]], while the bottom three (6th–8th place) were sent to the [[LCS/Europe/2014/Spring/Promotion|2014 Spring Promotion]].

==Format==
* '''Group Stage'''
:* Each team plays all other teams 4 times
:* Each team plays 28 matches
:* All Matches are {{Abbr/Bo1}}
:** 1st to 6th place will play the playoffs
:** 1st and 2nd receive playoff byes into the semifinals
:* 7th and 8th place will play the [[LCS/Europe/2014/Spring/Promotion|Promotion]]
* '''Playoffs'''
:* Single Elimination 
:** Matches are {{Abbr/Bo3}} 
:** Final is {{Abbr/Bo5}}
:* Top 5 qualifies for [[Battle_Of_The_Atlantic/2013|Battle of the Atlantic 2013]]
:* Top 3 qualifies for [[World_Championship/2013|Season 3 World Championship]]
